title: Configuration Reference
description: The version of a project's contract a record was decided under. A project's contract is kept as numbered versions; each change is a new version, never an edit. A record that names its version can be read against the terms it was decided under after the contract has changed.

contractVersion.description: The version's number in the contract's history.

documentSha256.description: SHA-256 of the version's canonical document, so a reader can confirm the version it reads is the one named.
